quests.instruction: Your teacher suddenly announces a fun field trip tomorrow. How do you feel?
quests.hint: Hearing news you never saw coming can make your eyes go wide.
quests.explanation: Hearing exciting news out of nowhere, with no warning at all, gives you a burst of surprise.
quests.funFact: Surprising news can feel even more fun because you never saw it coming!

quests.instruction: You finally learn to ride your bike without training wheels. How do you feel?
quests.hint: Mastering something you practiced for a long time can make you want to cheer.
quests.explanation: Mastering something you practiced hard for, like biking alone, gives you a warm, accomplished feeling.
quests.funFact: Balancing on two wheels takes practice for almost everyone — you did it!

quests.instruction: Someone you just met asks to sit with you at lunch. How do you feel?
quests.hint: Sitting with someone new for the first time can make you feel quiet at first.
quests.explanation: Sitting with someone you just met can feel a little quiet and unsure until you get to know them.
quests.funFact: Asking someone about their favorite games is a fun way to start a new friendship!

quests.instruction: You stayed up much later than your normal bedtime. How do you feel?
quests.hint: Missing out on your usual sleep can make your eyes feel heavy the next day.
quests.explanation: Staying up later than usual means your body missed some rest, so it feels sleepy now.
quests.funFact: Growing bodies need lots of sleep to help kids grow strong and healthy!

quests.instruction: You are waiting in a very long line with nothing to do. How do you feel?
quests.hint: Standing still for a long time with nothing to look at can make minutes feel like hours.
quests.explanation: Waiting a long time with nothing to do can make the minutes feel slow and dull.
quests.funFact: Counting things around you, like colors or shapes, can help waiting feel faster!

quests.instruction: You get picked first for the team at recess. How do you feel?
quests.hint: Being chosen first by your friends can make your smile grow big.
quests.explanation: Being chosen first by your friends is a happy little moment of feeling valued.
quests.funFact: Taking turns picking teams helps make games fair and fun for everyone!

quests.instruction: Your brother uses your favorite marker and it runs dry. How do you feel?
quests.hint: Losing the use of something special because someone else used it all up feels unfair.
quests.explanation: Losing something special because someone else used it all up feels very frustrating.
quests.funFact: Asking before borrowing is a simple way friends and family can avoid this problem!

quests.instruction: Your class is going to the zoo tomorrow. How do you feel?
quests.hint: Thinking about seeing all sorts of animals tomorrow can make you talk extra fast.
quests.explanation: Thinking about seeing all kinds of animals tomorrow fills you with eager, happy energy.
quests.funFact: Zoos help take care of animals and teach visitors how to protect them in the wild!

quests.instruction: Your kite gets caught in a tree and rips. How do you feel?
quests.hint: Watching something you were enjoying get damaged can bring a little frown.
quests.explanation: Watching a fun toy like your kite get damaged can bring on a quiet, disappointed feeling.
quests.funFact: A grown-up can often help patch a small rip so your kite can fly again!

quests.instruction: You watch a spooky puppet show at the fair. How do you feel?
quests.hint: Watching something with sudden pops and spooky sounds can make you jump a little.
quests.explanation: Sudden pops and spooky sounds in a show can give you a quick, jumpy feeling.
quests.funFact: Puppet shows use surprise on purpose to make the story feel extra fun and thrilling!

quests.instruction: You open your lunch box and find a sweet note from home. How do you feel?
quests.hint: Finding something unplanned tucked inside your lunch can make you gasp a little.
quests.explanation: Finding an unplanned little note tucked inside your lunch gives you a small burst of surprise.
quests.funFact: Small unexpected notes are a sweet way families say 'I am thinking of you'!

quests.instruction: You finish your art project after working on it for days. How do you feel?
quests.hint: Completing something you spent a long time working on feels like a big win.
quests.explanation: Completing something you worked on for days gives you a warm feeling of accomplishment.
quests.funFact: Artists often work on one piece for a long time before it feels finished!

quests.instruction: You have to sing a song alone in front of everyone. How do you feel?
quests.hint: Singing all by yourself with everyone watching can make your cheeks feel warm.
quests.explanation: Singing alone with everyone watching can make you feel a little quiet and unsure inside.
quests.funFact: Even famous singers say they still feel this way before some performances!

quests.instruction: You climbed all the stairs in a tall building. How do you feel?
quests.hint: Lots of climbing can make your legs feel a little wobbly and slow.
quests.explanation: Climbing many stairs takes a lot of energy, so your legs feel worn out afterward.
quests.funFact: Climbing stairs is actually great exercise for your legs and your heart!

quests.instruction: You have already played with every toy in your room today. How do you feel?
quests.hint: Running out of new things to do can make the afternoon feel very slow.
quests.explanation: Running out of new things to do can make the afternoon feel slow and a little dull.
quests.funFact: Combining two old toys together can sometimes make a brand new game!

quests.instruction: Your whole family sings happy birthday to you. How do you feel?
quests.hint: Hearing people you love celebrate just for you feels warm inside.
quests.explanation: Hearing the people you love celebrate just for you fills your heart with happiness.
quests.funFact: Birthday songs are sung in different tunes and languages all around the world!

quests.instruction: Someone erases your answer on the classroom board. How do you feel?
quests.hint: Watching your work get erased by someone else does not feel fair.
quests.explanation: Watching your work get erased by someone else feels very unfair and frustrating.
quests.funFact: Telling your teacher calmly can help fix mix-ups like this quickly.

quests.instruction: You get invited to a friend's pool party this weekend. How do you feel?
quests.hint: Thinking about splashing and playing all weekend can make you want to check the calendar.
quests.explanation: Thinking ahead to a fun pool party fills you with eager, bouncy energy.
quests.funFact: Counting down the days on a calendar is a fun way to enjoy the wait!

quests.instruction: Your favorite show gets cancelled right before the ending. How do you feel?
quests.hint: Missing out on the ending of something you loved can leave you feeling a little down.
quests.explanation: Missing the ending of something you were enjoying can leave you with a quiet, disappointed feeling.
quests.funFact: You can often catch the ending later — many shows can be watched again!

quests.instruction: A big wave splashes over you at the beach unexpectedly. How do you feel?
quests.hint: An unexpected splash of cold water can make your whole body jump.
quests.explanation: An unexpected splash of water can give your whole body a sudden, jumpy feeling.
quests.funFact: Watching the waves before you swim can help you know when a big one is coming!

quests.instruction: A friend you have not seen in a long time knocks on your door. How do you feel?
quests.hint: Seeing someone appear when you least expected it can make your jaw drop.
quests.explanation: Seeing someone appear when you least expected it gives you a big jump of surprise.
quests.funFact: Reuniting with someone after a long time is one of the most common reasons people feel this way!

quests.instruction: You help your little sister learn to count to ten. How do you feel?
quests.hint: Helping someone else learn something new can make you feel like a great helper.
quests.explanation: Helping someone else learn something new gives you a warm feeling of accomplishment.
quests.funFact: Teaching someone else is also a great way to make sure you remember something well!

quests.instruction: You meet your new neighbor for the very first time. How do you feel?
quests.hint: Meeting someone brand new can make it hard to find the right words.
quests.explanation: Meeting someone brand new can make it feel a little hard to find the right words at first.
quests.funFact: It often only takes a few minutes of talking for this quiet feeling to fade away!

quests.instruction: You just finished a whole day of running around at the park. How do you feel?
quests.hint: After a lot of running and playing, your legs might feel heavy and slow.
quests.explanation: After running and playing for a long time, your body needs rest to feel strong again.
quests.funFact: Your muscles use up energy when you play hard, so resting helps them recharge!

quests.instruction: You have watched the same show three times already today. How do you feel?
quests.hint: Watching something you already know by heart can make it feel a little dull.
quests.explanation: Watching the very same thing again and again can start to feel dull after a while.
quests.funFact: Trying a brand-new show or book is a fun way to feel curious again!

quests.instruction: Your class gets a surprise visit from a magician. How do you feel?
quests.hint: An unplanned visitor with tricks up their sleeve can make the whole room gasp.
quests.explanation: An unplanned, exciting visitor with tricks up their sleeve gives everyone a burst of surprise.
quests.funFact: Magicians use surprise on purpose — it is part of what makes their tricks so fun to watch!

quests.instruction: You share your snack with a friend who forgot their lunch. How do you feel?
quests.hint: Doing something kind and helpful for someone else can make your heart feel warm.
quests.explanation: Doing something kind and helpful for a friend gives you a warm feeling of accomplishment.
quests.funFact: Being kind to others is one of the best ways to feel good about yourself!

quests.instruction: A stranger says hello to you at the store. How do you feel?
quests.hint: Talking to someone you do not know yet can make you want to look down.
quests.explanation: Talking to someone unfamiliar can make you feel a little quiet and unsure at first.
quests.funFact: A small smile back is a gentle way to say hello even if you feel quiet inside.

quests.instruction: It is very late at night and your eyes keep closing. How do you feel?
quests.hint: When it is very late, your eyelids can feel heavy, like they want to close on their own.
quests.explanation: Late at night, your body naturally wants to rest, so your eyes feel heavy and want to close.
quests.funFact: Your body makes a sleepy chemical at night that helps tell you it is bedtime!

quests.instruction: It is a long car ride with nothing new to look at. How do you feel?
quests.hint: A long ride with the same view outside can make time feel very slow.
quests.explanation: A long ride with nothing new to see can make the trip feel slow and dull.
quests.funFact: Playing a spotting game, like finding red cars, can turn a dull ride into a fun one!
